researchAreas: LLM tool use for active perception
fitReason: Technical-fit HRI backup with current multimodal-LLM attention control research. Practical availability is constrained: the lab normally prefers visits of at least four months, with only occasional summer-intern exceptions mentioned. This is not a verified eight-week route.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full February 2026 MIT/CMU preprint implements real-time multimodal LLM function calls on actual Jibo gaze/attention control, with a qualitative Reachy Mini transfer. YOLO11-pose and SAM3 provide local person/object tracking; geometric binding turns detections or remembered views into gaze targets. The learned high-level system selects attention and perception tools, rather than manipulating objects or navigating a mobile base. Evaluation records six scenarios under four system variants, yielding 24 interaction videos rated by observers; this is not a 24-person deployment. Current coauthorship is verified, but lead authors and principal hardware work are MIT-linked, so current CMU-owned apparatus or visitor access is not inferred.
